122721.subject: Botany
122721.text: What is the definition of a simple leaf?

A leaf with an undivided lamina
A leaf without a bud in the axil

Gibberellins also promotes bolting (internode elongation just prior to flowering) in beet, cabbages and many plants with rosette habit.
